intent=i007 snapshot=s01 branch=expand-cow-invalidates-pointer status=complete
finding location=net/appletalk/ddp.c:1332-1338 confidence=medium conclusion=atalk_route_packet writes through the ddp pointer captured before skb_trim(), which can call pskb_expand_head on a cloned skb and free the old head, yielding a stale-pointer write (UAF) on received DDP packets.
limitation=No run-time reproduction was performed (no build or KASAN harness), so the pskb_expand_head reallocation on the cloned-receive path is inferred from the skb_cloned() branch in ___pskb_trim() (net/core/skbuff.c:2524-2525) rather than observed.
limitation=AppleTalk must be configured (an atalk interface and route) and the skb must arrive cloned and with len above the trim target for the reallocating trim to fire; if skbs are never cloned on that receive path the write stays in-bounds and the issue is latent.
limitation=The scanner used for candidate enumeration had a defect (it emitted no output for any of the 262 files), so coverage of this branch beyond the manually confirmed ddp.c case is not established.
